title: Freelance Sales Engineer
description:
**About MetrixOne**

MetrixOne supplies process instrumentation and wireless IoT solutions to industrial plants across India: flow, level, pressure, and temperature measurement, plus LoRaWAN-based remote monitoring. Our customers span pharma, food & beverage, chemicals, steel, water utilities, and general manufacturing. We support clients from product selection through commissioning and long-term service.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a freelance Sales Engineer to work remotely with our team, owning technical and commercial conversations from first inquiry to order.

**What you’ll do**

* Engage prospects and existing customers to understand their application requirements
* Recommend the right flowmeter, level, pressure, temperature or IoT and Wireless solution and prepare technical proposals and quotations
* Run online product demos and answer technical queries
* Coordinate with our engineering team on configuration and integration
* Provide pre- and post-sales support and help resolve application issues
* Follow up consistently and keep leads and proposals updated in our CRM
* Contribute to product documentation and training material

**What we’re looking for**

* 4+ years in industrial instrumentation, automation, or IoT sales or application engineering
* Working knowledge of at least some of: flowmeters, level sensors, pressure/temperature transmitters, wireless monitoring
* Degree in Instrumentation, Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent hands-on experience)
* Clear written and verbal communication with both engineers and procurement teams
* Self-managed and reliable on a contract basis

**Nice to have**

* Existing contacts or experience in Cement, Pharma, F&B, chemicals, steel, or water sectors
* Experience with CRM tools and preparing technical offers
* Fluency in Hindi/Marathi alongside English

**Engagement details**

* Territory: Pan-India
* Compensation: Commission %, retainer, or per-project rate to be discussed over meet
* Leads: Candidate’s own network

**Why work with us**

You’ll work directly with the founders, get hands-on exposure to a broad product range, and have room to grow into a longer-term partnership as we scale.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Associate Manager – Sales**

Zeassetz | Zolo

**Qualify sharply. Present confidently. Close with structure.**

**Why this role exists**

Zeassetz is scaling its on-ground sales presence.

In real estate, walk-ins and site visits are high-intent moments.

But intent does not automatically convert to booking.

Customers come with: Questions, Comparison, Negotiation, Doubt.

Without structured qualification, commercial clarity, and disciplined follow-up — serious buyers are lost.

This role exists to ensure that every qualified inquiry is handled with structure, confidence, and margin discipline — and converted into predictable site revenue.

**Your mandate is clear:**

* Qualify customers before pitching
* Convert site visits into serious negotiations
* Protect project margins during discussions
* Maintain disciplined follow-up and CRM visibility
* Drive monthly booking targets consistently

This is not a brochure-explanation role. It is a structured closing role.

**About Zolo And Zeassetz**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Zeassetz enables structured real estate ownership and asset-backed growth opportunities.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life — as residents, travelers, guests, and investors.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners and asset partners who think long term.

**What you will be responsible for**

**Drive Structured Customer Qualification**

* Greet walk-ins professionally
* Ask structured qualification questions (budget, timeline, purpose)
* Identify decision-maker involvement
* Align project pitch to customer profile
* Adapt tone based on seriousness of buyer

**Demonstrate Strong Product Mastery**

* Explain pricing structure confidently
* Break down payment plans clearly
* Communicate project USP sharply
* Handle competitor comparison professionally
* Conduct structured and persuasive site walkthroughs

**Handle Objections with Negotiation Discipline**

* Listen fully to objections
* Identify whether concern is price, trust, or timing
* Use approved negotiation frameworks
* Escalate beyond-approval cases correctly
* Push toward booking decision confidently

**Maintain Follow-Up Discipline & Lead Management**

* Update CRM immediately after meetings
* Categorize leads accurately (Hot / Warm / Cold)
* Schedule structured follow-ups
* Maintain professional WhatsApp communication
* Track negotiation stages clearly

**Ensure Booking Closure & Documentation Discipline**

* Explain booking process clearly
* Coordinate documentation efficiently
* Ensure agreement accuracy
* Avoid last-minute confusion
* Follow through until booking confirmation

**Own Target & Site Performance**

* Know daily and monthly targets clearly
* Track personal booking gap daily
* Push mid-month correction if lagging
* Participate actively in site performance reviews
* Align pipeline with Sales Manager

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You are comfortable qualifying before pitching
* You handle price discussions calmly
* You are confident asking for booking
* You track your numbers daily
* You are structured in follow-ups
* You prefer outcome-driven roles

**Experience we value**

* 2–4 years in real estate or site-based sales roles
* Strong experience handling walk-in customers
* Comfortable with negotiation discussions
* CRM discipline and documentation clarity
* Target-driven mindset

Real estate exposure preferred. Performance discipline is non-negotiable.

**The impact you will have**

You will directly influence site revenue stability.

You will protect margins during negotiation.

You will shape how customers perceive the project’s professionalism.

**Why join now**

Zeassetz is scaling its real estate portfolio.

As inventory expands, disciplined site-level sales execution will determine revenue quality.

If you believe qualification, negotiation, and closure are structured crafts — this is the right moment.

title: Sales Executive

**Company Description**

Plypicker is India’s first end-to-end interior design, construction, and furniture ecosystem, integrating design vision with manufacturing precision and on-site execution. Unlike traditional firms that coordinate multiple vendors, Plypicker owns the entire value chain, from in-house furniture manufacturing and curated materials supply to expert project delivery. The company offers interior design and consultancy, complete project execution, custom and modular furniture, and access to premium materials and skilled trade professionals. Plypicker focuses on creating spaces that look, feel, and perform to high standards of durability and quality. Its commitment is to designs built with intent, executed with precision, and delivered without compromise.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Sales Executive role based in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area. The Sales Executive will identify and qualify leads, build and nurture relationships with residential and commercial clients, and present Plypicker’s integrated interior, construction, and furniture solutions. Daily responsibilities include conducting client meetings and site visits, preparing proposals and quotations, negotiating terms, and closing deals in line with revenue targets. The role involves collaborating with design, operations, and manufacturing teams to ensure accurate scopes of work and smooth project handovers. The Sales Executive will also track sales activities in CRM tools, gather market intelligence, and represent Plypicker at local events or industry networking opportunities.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales and business development skills, including prospecting, lead qualification, and closing deals.
* Client relationship management abilities, with experience in managing long sales cycles and high-value projects.
* Knowledge of interior design, construction, or furniture solutions, or the ability and willingness to quickly learn these domains.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with proficiency in explaining technical and design concepts in simple terms.
* Solid negotiation and objection-handling capabilities, with a focus on win–win outcomes.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Interior Design, or a related field is preferred; relevant experience in B2C or B2B sales can substitute.
* Previous experience in interiors, real estate, construction, or furniture sales is an advantage.
* Self-driven, organized, and capable of meeting ambitious sales targets while maintaining high professional standards.

title: Account Management Specialist - Senior
description:
**Job Summary**
Responsible for managing customer relationships and account strategies for less complex accounts, including regional, single-business-unit, or internal accounts. The role may also support larger and more complex accounts in partnership with senior account management leaders.
  
  
The position is responsible for driving sales of Cummins products and services to assigned business customers, expanding existing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and executing account plans aligned with business strategy and revenue objectives. The role acts as a key customer interface and advocate for the voice of the customer within Cummins.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, manage, and maintain strong business relationships with assigned accounts in alignment with the organization's sales strategy.
* Develop and execute account strategies and sales plans to achieve revenue, growth, customer satisfaction, and business objectives.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities and support initiatives that contribute to revenue growth and cost reduction.
* Expand sales of Cummins products and services within existing customer accounts by understanding customer requirements and identifying opportunities for growth.
* Lead and coordinate customer communication and interfaces at appropriate stakeholder levels.
* Negotiate and implement customer contracts within established authorization and business guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to address production, distribution, service, inventory, and delivery requirements associated with assigned accounts.
* Act as a champion for the voice of the customer and ensure customer needs and feedback are effectively represented within the business.
* Measure customer satisfaction, identify improvement areas, and develop action plans to strengthen the customer experience.
* Support and drive account strategy execution by collaborating with key stakeholders across functions and business units.
* Drive cross-business-unit account development initiatives in support of broader account strategies.
* Lead Customer Focus Six Sigma initiatives and other improvement activities aimed at strengthening customer relationships and business performance.
* Manage accounts receivable deliverables, including discussions and negotiations related to payment terms, as applicable.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts and track performance, progress, and forecast accuracy against business targets.
* Monitor account performance, relationship strength, product competitiveness, quality, service, and other key factors to identify risks and opportunities.
* Balance customer requirements with business capabilities related to inventory, service, and delivery, in collaboration with internal stakeholders and customers.
* Use customer and market insights to support account planning, pipeline development, and long-term business growth.

**Key Competencies**
**Customer & Relationship Management**

* Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions.
* Communicates Effectively: Tailors communication across different audiences and stakeholder levels to convey complex information clearly.
* Integrates Customer Perspective: Uses customer insights to improve sales effectiveness, customer experience, and revenue growth.
* Instills Trust: Builds credibility through honesty, integrity, transparency, and authentic interactions.
* Values Differences: Recognizes and leverages diverse perspectives and experiences.

**Commercial & Account Management**

* Account Planning: Defines objectives, monitors progress, and drives execution against account and business targets.
* Developing Account Strategy: Evaluates account relationships, financial performance, product competitiveness, quality, service, barriers, customer requirements, and business capabilities to define achievable account strategies.
* Articulates Value Proposition: Understands customer requirements and effectively communicates the value of Cummins products, solutions, and services against customer needs and competitive alternatives.
* Pricing Strategy: Develops and supports pricing approaches by building alignment with relevant stakeholders to achieve business objectives.
* Channel Awareness: Understands industry structure, market dynamics, and routes to market to support business growth.

**Sales & Business Development**

* Sales Forecasting: Analyzes internal and external customer data and historical trends to support accurate sales forecasts and future consumption planning.
* Sales Pipeline Management: Monitors pipeline health, prioritizes opportunities, identifies gaps, and supports actions required to achieve sales objectives.
* Sense Making: Uses research, probing, and analysis to understand customer needs, buying behavior, and business drivers and translates insights into relevant solutions and actions.
* Adapts to Target Audience: Communicates technical, commercial, and business information appropriately for different audiences.

**Leadership & Execution**

* Ensures Accountability: Takes ownership of commitments and follows through on deliverables and agreed actions.

We are looking for an experienced and polished PMS Sales & Client Relationship professional to join our growing wealth management business.

This will be a key front-facing role and one of the initial hires for our PMS vertical. The individual will work closely with senior management and will be responsible for engaging with prospective HNI clients, presenting our investment proposition, converting opportunities, and managing relationships through the onboarding process.

·      Strong understanding of equity markets, investment products and portfolio management.

·      Prior PMS sales/client relationship experience would be strongly preferred.

·      Comfortable discussing investment strategies, portfolio construction and performance with sophisticated investors.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) (Night Shift)
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Sales Development Representative (SDR), based in Pune, is a dedicated pipeline-generation engine for OpenGov's US go-to-market team. This role is built for outbound specialists who want to master high-volume prospecting into the US public sector market, working US-aligned hours to connect directly with government decision-makers in real time. You'll partner closely with US-based Sales Development Representatives and Account Executives to build and qualify pipeline.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Generate pipeline for the US market: run high-volume outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach into assigned US territories (cities, counties, special districts, and state agencies)
* Work US-aligned hours: align your schedule to the US territories you support so you're reaching decision-makers in real time
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads against OpenGov's ICP and hand off sales-ready opportunities to US-based Account Executives
* Build enough fluency in OpenGov's cloud-based platform to speak credibly about the problems it solves for cities, counties, and government agencies
* Use Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn daily to manage pipeline, prioritize leads, and log activity with precision
* Clearly and persuasively articulate OpenGov's value to US government decision-makers and quickly establish credibility
* Hit weekly outbound activity and pipeline targets while staying disciplined about lead quality
* Collaborate with marketing by following up on inbound and campaign-generated leads to maximize lead-to-opportunity conversion
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce for all prospecting activity

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in SDR, Sales or a customer-facing role
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to cold-call US-based government decision-makers and quickly build rapport
* Comfortable working US-aligned hours from Pune
* A natural communicator who's confident talking to people you've never met, and knows how to make them glad you called
* Genuinely curious about technology and its role in government, with a competitive drive and real passion for pushing the public sector forward
* Excited by AI and what it means for government: able to speak to it credibly and see it as a differentiator in every conversation
* Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce or similar) is a plus
* Background in B2B, SaaS, outbound prospecting, BPO, or government is a bonus, but not expected at this level
* Bachelor's degree preferred

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

description:
Business Development & Sales
  
Department: Business Development & Sales
  
Location: Pune
  
Industry: EPC / Engineering / Fabrication / Piping & Tank Solutions
  
Experience: 3–7 Years
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
1. JOB PURPOSE
  
The Business Development & Sales professional will be responsible for driving the company's business growth by identifying new markets and sectors, generating new enquiries, developing client relationships, managing the sales pipeline, and converting opportunities into profitable orders.
  
The role will have end-to-end ownership of the business development process:
  
Market Identification → Target Sectors → Target Clients → Lead Generation → Client Meetings → Enquiry Generation → CRM Management → Quotation Follow-up → Negotiation → Order Conversion → Repeat Business
  
The position will also be responsible for coordinating and monitoring SEO/digital marketing activities with external agencies and ensuring that marketing efforts contribute to relevant business enquiries.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
A. Business Development & New Client Acquisition
  
• Identify and develop new customers across relevant industries and sectors.
  
• Generate qualified leads through direct outreach, client references, networking, industry databases, digital channels and market research.
  
• Build and continuously maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
  
• Research companies, upcoming projects, plant expansions, capex plans and procurement requirements.
  
• Identify key decision-makers and establish relationships with relevant stakeholders.
  
• Convert prospects into enquiries and enquiries into business opportunities.
  
• Develop new accounts and increase business from existing customers.
  
• Maintain regular follow-ups until the opportunity is closed, lost or clearly deferred.
  
B. Market & Sector Development
  
• Identify new industries, applications and sectors where the company's EPC, fabrication, tank, piping and engineering capabilities can be offered.
  
• Conduct market research to identify sectors with strong business potential.
  
• Prepare sector-wise target customer lists.
  
• Identify upcoming projects and companies investing in new plants, capacity expansion or infrastructure.
  
• Study competitor activity, market demand and customer requirements.
  
• Recommend new products, services or applications that the company can potentially develop.
  
• Present new market opportunities and business potential to management.
  
C. Client Visits & Relationship Management
  
• Conduct regular meetings with existing and prospective clients.
  
• Understand customer requirements, upcoming projects, technical expectations and procurement processes.
  
• Build relationships with purchase, project, engineering, maintenance and management teams.
  
• Record all important client discussions and follow-up requirements.
  
• Maintain regular contact with key clients even when there is no immediate enquiry.
  
• Identify opportunities for repeat business, cross-selling and additional projects.
  
D. CRM Ownership & Sales Pipeline Management
  
• Take complete ownership of the company's CRM system.
  
• Ensure 100% of relevant leads and enquiries are recorded in the CRM.
  
• Maintain accurate information on:
  
o Lead source
  
o Client details
  
o Requirement
  
o Enquiry value
  
o Quotation status
  
o Probability
  
o Expected closure date
  
o Next follow-up
  
o Opportunity stage
  
• Monitor the complete sales funnel from Lead to Order.
  
• Ensure no enquiry or follow-up is missed.
  
• Review the CRM regularly and clean outdated/inactive opportunities.
  
• Prepare weekly and monthly pipeline reports for management.
  
• Analyse conversion ratios, lost enquiries, lead sources and sector-wise opportunities.
  
E. Enquiry, Quotation & Order Conversion
  
• Understand and qualify new enquiries.
  
• Coordinate with estimation, technical, procurement and project teams for timely quotation preparation.
  
• Follow up on submitted quotations.
  
• Understand customer objections and commercial/technical concerns.
  
• Coordinate negotiations with the relevant internal teams.
  
• Track expected order closure dates.
  
• Record reasons for lost enquiries.
  
• Ensure proper handover of confirmed orders to the execution/project team.
  
F. SEO & Digital Marketing Coordination
  
• Coordinate with external SEO/digital marketing agencies.
  
• Monitor

title: Customer Renewal Manager
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Customer Renewal Manager (CRM) is responsible for driving the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for assigned customers in a defined Unit/Area. As part of Teradata’s Go-To-Market (GTM) organization, this position will serve as the primary role responsible for sustaining/renewing customers and growing our ARR baseline. The CRM will partner closely with the Account team including Customer Experience and Finance to ensure effective account collaboration and cancels and erosions prevention.
  
  
The CRM will be responsible for managing several customers to business objectives including recurring revenue retention and growth, on-time renewal execution, expansions, and outlook accuracy. The CRM will work with the account team on account planning to identify customer needs/risks and opportunities both in preparation for upcoming renewals as well as mid-term adjustments and Cloud opportunities. The CRM is responsible for being the expert in Teradata’s renewal/sustainment strategy and works directly with the customer to negotiate standard and custom renewals including terms, SLAs and penalties. The CRM will align the renewal strategy with the Account Executive (AE), Customer Solution Architect (CSA) and wider account team to achieve optimal results.
  
  
A key responsibility of the CRM is completing and executing preventive actions on Cancellations and Erosions, leveraging early insights and collaborating with Field Technology Management, Services Delivery Management and Customer Services Management. The CRM will be responsible for the development, application and delivery of cancel and erosion save plans alongside the Customer Services Architect (CSA), with the aim to increase customer retention and revenue retention; in addition to the identification of upsell and cross sell.
  
  
As an integrated member of the GTM account team, this role is primarily responsible for retaining recurring revenue across Teradata’s business through exceptional renewal sales execution. This includes building and maintaining strong partnerships with both internal and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Renewal Scope Areas Include**
:
  
  

* Basic understanding of the components that make up a renewal in order to articulate the e2e solution.
* Understanding of sales process including managing account relationships and customer interaction.
* Renewals includes any revenue in Teradata that has been previously sold and should be retained through repeat contracting on a scheduled basis, including Term, Cloud, Maintenance and SWUR.
* Turn-key Renewals: CRM will own the oversight of the renewal process, managing customer engagement supported by the process from the back-office teams.
* Upsell/Cross-Sell/New-Sell: In certain circumstances the CRM will own the sales cycle for the generation of new revenue. This will be part of the normal renewal lifecycle in accounts, where there is opportunity to expand the scope of the renewal to new business, like increasing a customer support Success Tier and Cloud services.
* Customer Presentations: Prepare and deliver customer presentations to align with business objectives and ensure common understanding of scope of work and renewal strategy. description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Key Account Manager (KAM) is the dedicated owner of aftermarket revenue and customer relationships for a defined set of strategic accounts that collectively represent a large share of addressable AM revenue in the region. The KAM is the single commercial point of contact at these accounts for spare parts, M-Powered contracts, retrofits and any other new AM offerings, and is responsible for converting whitespace into recurring aftermarket revenue.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Account Ownership & Revenue Growth**

* Manage assigned strategic accounts end-to-end for all aftermarket revenue streams
* Deliver the assigned account-level AM revenue target across spares, M-Powered, retrofits and new AM products
* Convert whitespaces in assigned regions – identify under-penetrated SKUs, machines and product categories and activate them
* Build and protect Milacron's entitlement value (SOM) capture at each account

**Customer Engagement & Coverage**

* Maintain a structured visit / call plan (PJP) across assigned accounts – minimum weekly customer visits and calls per defined cadence
* Build relationships across plant-level and corporate-level decision-makers (maintenance, procurement, plant heads)
* Handle commercial and service-related escalations in coordination with the Regional Service team (Regional Service Managers and Service Engineers)

**Contracting & Upsell**

* Push Milacron spare part sales, consumable kits, and structured replacement programs
* Drive M-Powered contract closures; build the pipeline at the account level

title: Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT TIC**

Till It Clicks Studio Pvt. Ltd. (TIC) is a marketing and creative agency based in Sahakarnagar, Pune. AI plays a growing role across TIC's delivery functions. Account Management is deliberately kept fully human, because we believe our clients deserve people-to-people interaction. AI supports the backend, but the face of TIC to every client will always be a person. 

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Account Management is the backbone of every client relationship at TIC. It sits between the client and the delivery team, and between what was promised and what gets delivered. Its job is to keep clients retained, happy and growing. This is not a communication-relay role. As an Account Manager, you will think like a marketer, act like an owner, and be accountable for the health of every account you handle. You will typically own four to six client accounts at a time and work closely with the Account Management Lead, the Studio Head and the delivery team. 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client management**

Take full ownership of all deliverables across your assigned accounts (typically four to six clients). Respond to client messages promptly and proactively, with clear timelines rather than vague assurances, so clients always feel valued and heard. 

Keep all client communication in writing. Document any verbal brief, revision or instruction, share it with the client for confirmation, and only then act on it. 

Take notes in every client meeting and share them with the client and the delivery team after every interaction. 

Plan as many client tasks as possible before the start of each month. Share the next day's tasks with the Studio Head by the previous evening, or by 10:00 AM the same day. 

Build personal relationships with clients, down to acknowledging birthdays and important moments.
**Reporting & strategy**

 

Daily/weekly: Update the task tracking document daily and track all deliverables against the committed scope every week. 

Monthly: Send each client a qualitative and quantitative report, built from insights gathered from the relevant delivery team members. Attend a relationship-building meeting with every client alongside the Account Management Lead. 

Quarterly: Plan each client's strategy for the next quarter well in advance. Once it is approved, get full clarity on the quarter's deliverables. 

Take part in strategy reviews at the start and end of every month, contributing as a thinking partner who understands the strategy behind each account, not just the tasks. 

Never commit a timeline to a client without first confirming it with the relevant delivery team member.
**Delivery & process**

Give the delivery team written briefs that are detailed and unambiguous, to avoid costly reworks. Make sure every deliverable is quality-checked before it reaches the client. 

Run all tasks, briefs and updates through TIC's project management tool.

**Sales & growth**

Actively look for upselling opportunities to grow the scope of every account. Upselling is a major KPI for this role. 

Support the sales team with proposals and pitches when needed, especially with account context and client knowledge. 

Track payments for each client and, working with the Accounts team, proactively follow up on delayed payments. 

**AI-first ways of working**

Use TIC's AI-powered account management processes to cut the time spent on repetitive work (briefing, reporting, task planning) without lowering the quality of client communication or the depth of relationships. 

Update your client CIDs every month, in a meaningful and detailed way. 

Fill in timesheets accurately.

**REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS**

A client-first, ownership mindset, with a strong focus on long-term retention and relationships. The ability to think like a marketer and understand the strategy behind a client's account, not just the task list. 

Excellent written communication, including clear, detailed briefs, meeting notes and client reports. Strong planning and organisation skills, with the ability to plan work a month ahead and track scope weekly across several accounts. 

Proactiveness: spotting early signs of client distress and raising flags with solutions, not just problems. An eye for quality and the discipline to follow process (PM tool, trackers, timesheets). Commercial awareness to spot upsell opportunities and follow up on payments. 

Comfort working with AI tools to make repetitive work more efficient.

title: Assistant Manager Sales
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As an
**Assistant Manager Sales**
, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
  
  

* Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
* Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
* Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
* Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
* Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
* Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
* Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
* Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
* Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
* Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
* Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
* Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

**About Us**
**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Program Counselor
description:
**Company Description**
Imarticus Learning is a leading education provider that offers high-quality, industry-specific programs through innovative technology, specialized training, and mentorship from industry professionals. In over a decade, the organization has impacted more than one million learners, supported by experienced faculty, 20+ premier institute partners, and 3,500+ global hiring partners. Imarticus delivers Job Assured Programs, Global Accounting and Finance Programs, Executive Education, and Senior Leadership Programs designed to build practical, industry-ready skills. Its blended teaching methodology includes immersive live lectures (online and offline), hybrid learning modules, peer discussions, industry seminars, capstone projects, guest lectures, and soft skills training. The company is widely recognized with multiple awards for its contributions to digital learning, finance education, analytics, and workforce skilling.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Program Counselor role based in the Pune Division. The Program Counselor will guide prospective learners through program options, understand their career goals, and recommend suitable courses that align with their aspirations and background. The role includes handling inbound and outbound calls, responding to inquiries via email and messaging platforms, conducting counseling sessions, and following up with leads to support enrollment. The Program Counselor will collaborate with academic, marketing, and operations teams to ensure a smooth admission experience and accurate communication of program features, outcomes, and policies. They will also maintain detailed records in CRM systems, track conversions, and provide feedback from learners and prospects to improve offerings and processes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong counseling, advising, or academic guidance skills, with the ability to understand learner needs and recommend appropriate programs.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with a customer-centric and empathetic approach.
* Sales and relationship-building abilities, including lead nurturing, objection handling, and conversion-focused follow-ups.
* Proficiency with basic computer applications and CRM or admission management tools, along with accurate data entry and documentation skills.
* Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple inquiries, meet targets, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; education, business, psychology, or related fields are advantageous.
* Previous experience in education counseling, admissions, inside sales, or customer service is preferred, especially within edtech or higher education.
* Comfort working on-site in the Pune Division and flexibility to work extended or weekend hours during peak admission periods, if required.

title: Sales Intern (B2B SaaS, Construction Tech)
description:
**About ArcSetu:**

ArcSetu is an Indian software company that builds operations software for interior design and construction firms. Our first product, Niti, runs a firm from first enquiry to final bill: leads, BOQs and estimates, project schedules, material requests and purchase orders, site inventory, approvals, running bills and GST-ready accounts, all on one set of records.

Most firms we meet still run their sites on WhatsApp groups, Excel sheets, paper challans and phone calls. Niti replaces that with software that site engineers actually open on their phones and that the office can trust. We are a small team, and we spend time on site with the people who use our software.

**About the Role:**

You will help bring Niti to interior fit-out firms, design-build studios, contractors and developers. You'll work directly with the founding team, learn how construction businesses really run, and own a part of our pipeline from first message to booked demo.

**What you will do:**

* Visit client offices and project sites with the team to see the work first-hand
* Keep every lead up to date in our CRM, which is Niti's own leads pipeline (Inquiry → Site Visit → Proposal → Negotiation)

**What we are looking for?**

* A graduate with 0 to 1 year of experience (BBA, MBA, B.Com, B.Arch, B.Des, Civil Engineering or any field)
* Clear, confident spoken and written English and Hindi; a regional language is a plus
* Comfortable making cold calls and talking to business owners
* Organised, follows up without being chased, and keeps notes
* Willing to travel within Pune for meetings and site visits

**What you get?**

* Stipend of ₹10,000 per month
* Performance incentives for closed deals
* Pre-placement offer (PPO) for strong performers
* Internship certificate and letter of recommendation
* Hands-on B2B SaaS sales experience in a fast-growing, under-served industry
* Direct mentorship from the founders

**Duration**
: 3 months, hybrid (Pune office + field visits)

**Start date**
: 16 November 2026

Apply on LinkedIn or email your CV to career@arcsetu.com.

In 2–3 lines, tell us how you would get an interior design firm owner to take a 20-minute call.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Job Description: Marketing & Sales Executive

**Company:**
DNYAN Automation Pvt. Ltd.

**Department:**
Sales & Business Development

**Experience:**
0–3 Years

**Qualification:**
Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Marketing & Sales Executive to support domestic and international business development in the Industrial Automation and Engineering Services sectors. The candidate will be responsible for lead generation, client relationship management, sales coordination, proposal follow-ups, and identifying new business opportunities in India and overseas markets.

Roles & Responsibilities1. Business Development & Lead Generation

* Identify and develop new customers in Industrial Automation, PLC, DCS, SIS, SCADA, HMI, ESD, and Fire & Gas Systems (FGS).
* Generate leads through LinkedIn, email campaigns, industry directories, EPC databases, exhibitions, customer references, and online research.
* Identify potential EPC contractors, OEMs, system integrators, engineering companies, and end users.
* Build and maintain a qualified database of prospective customers.

2. Client Communication & Relationship Management

* Contact prospective and existing customers through email, telephone, LinkedIn, and online meetings.
* Introduce DNYAN's engineering capabilities and automation services.
* Understand customer requirements and identify potential business opportunities.
* Maintain regular follow-ups and develop long-term customer relationships.
* Coordinate technical discussions between customers and the engineering team.

3. Sales & Order Conversion

* Generate enquiries and Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and convert them into business opportunities.
* Understand customer requirements, scope of work, and commercial expectations.
* Coordinate with the engineering team for technical feasibility, scope definition, man-hour estimation, proposals, and quotations.
* Prepare and submit commercial proposals and follow up until closure.
* Support commercial negotiations within approved company guidelines.
* Track the complete sales cycle from lead generation to order receipt and project execution.

4. International Business Development

* Identify business opportunities in the USA, Canada, Middle East, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Australia.
* Develop relationships with international system integrators and engineering companies.
* Identify opportunities for outsourcing automation engineering services to DNYAN.
* Promote services such as PLC programming, DCS engineering, SIS engineering, HMI/SCADA development, hardware engineering, documentation, FAT support, remote engineering, and AMC/technical support.
* Coordinate international meetings and follow-ups across different time zones.

5. Marketing Activities

* Plan and execute targeted B2B marketing campaigns.
* Prepare customer-specific introductory emails, presentations, and service proposals.
* Promote company capabilities through LinkedIn and other professional platforms.
* Coordinate the preparation of company presentations, capability statements, service brochures, case studies, and technical articles.
* Monitor competitor activities and identify new industries and geographical markets.

6. Coordination with Engineering & Operations

* Coordinate with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, and Accounts teams.
* Ensure customer requirements are clearly communicated to the engineering team.
* Follow up internally to ensure timely submission of proposals and quotations.
* Arrange customer meetings with technical personnel.
* Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities for upgrades, additional work, and AMC services.

7. Commercial & Payment Follow-up

* Support the commercial team in following up on pending customer invoices.
* Maintain records of customer payment commitments and payment status.
* Coordinate with internal teams regarding commercial issues and delayed payments.
* Escalate payment delays to management when required.

8. Reporting to Management

* Maintain daily and weekly reports covering new leads, customer contacts, meetings, enquiries, quotations, and follow-ups.
* Track quotation values, sales pipeline, opportunities won or lost, and expected order values.
* Maintain expected closure dates and customer payment status.
* Provide regular updates on business development and marketing activities.

Ideal Candidate ProfileEducation & Experience

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* 0–3 years of experience in B2B sales, marketing, lead generation, or business development.
* Experience in industrial automation, electrical, instrumentation, or engineering services will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication and business development skills may also be considered.

Technical Knowledge

Basic understanding of one or more of the following will be an advantage:

* PLC and DCS
* SCADA/HMI
* SIS/ESD
* Industrial instrumentation
* Control systems
* Industrial automation and engineering services

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Professional email drafting and customer communication.
* Lead generation and LinkedIn prospecting.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and negotiation skills.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and CRM tools.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and coordinate proposals.
* Willingness to communicate with international customers and work across different time zones.

**Preferred Candidate:**
A motivated individual with a strong interest in B2B sales, technical marketing, and domestic and international business development in the Industrial Automation sector.

ABOUT THE COMPANY
  

**EFFCO Finishes & Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**
 is an Indian technology-driven company specializing in advanced industrial coatings, metal surface engineering, functional coating chemicals and high-performance corrosion protection technologies.

We develop and commercialize innovative coating solutions designed to improve corrosion resistance, durability, friction performance and service life of industrial metal components.

Our technology portfolio includes:

* **ECOMET CORUNDUM®:**
   Advanced zinc flake / zinc lamellar protective coating systems.
* **CORUNDUM ONE®:**
   High-performance thin-film corrosion protection technology.
* **TITANIUM CDG™:**
   Specialized zinc-aluminium-titanium protective coating technology.
* **HEMATITE®:**
   Industrial black protective coating systems.
* **PTFE / Fluoropolymer Coatings:**
   Functional coatings for controlled friction, lubricity and specialized surface performance.
* **Dip-Spin Coating & Surface Treatment Technologies:**
   Application processes, coating machinery and technical solutions for industrial components.

EFFCO serves industrial customers across automotive, fasteners, solar energy, infrastructure, railways, power transmission, heavy engineering, construction equipment and related manufacturing sectors.

As part of our business expansion across India and international markets, we are strengthening our regional sales and business development network.

We are looking for professionals who can combine 
**technical expertise, established industrial customer relationships and strong commercial capabilities**
 to develop new business opportunities.

The Regional Sales Manager will be responsible for developing EFFCO's business within the assigned geographical territory.

The role involves identifying potential customers, promoting advanced industrial coating technologies, building relationships with OEMs and manufacturers, supporting technical product qualification and converting business opportunities into sustainable sales.

Candidates should possess a strong understanding of industrial coating applications and proven experience in technical B2B sales.

* Develop new business across the assigned regional industrial market.
* Identify prospective OEMs, fastener manufacturers, coating applicators and industrial customers.
* Generate qualified leads, develop sales pipelines and achieve agreed sales targets.
* Build long-term customer relationships and expand EFFCO's regional market presence.

**2. Technical Sales & Product Promotion**

* Promote zinc lamellar, zinc flake, industrial protective and functional coating technologies.
* Understand customer coating requirements, technical specifications and application challenges.
* Coordinate technical presentations, coating trials, sample evaluations and customer approvals with EFFCO's technical team.
* Support technical-commercial proposals, negotiations and customer conversion.

**3. OEM & Key Account Development**

* Establish relationships with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 and Tier-2 suppliers, fastener manufacturers, industrial equipment companies and engineering industries.
* Engage with customer engineering, quality, production and procurement teams.
* Identify opportunities for new coating specifications and long-term customer adoption.

**4. Market Development & Reporting**

* Monitor regional market opportunities, competitor technologies and industry developments.
* Identify suitable coating application partners and industrial distributors.
* Maintain sales forecasts, customer visit reports and opportunity pipelines.
* Coordinate with internal technical, manufacturing and commercial teams.

TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE PREFERRED

Candidates should have relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Industrial Paint Technology & Protective Coatings
* Surface Coating Technology & Metal Finishing
* Zinc Flake / Zinc Lamellar Dip-Spin Coatings
* Fastener Coatings & Industrial Surface Treatment
* PTFE / Fluoropolymer & Functional Coatings
* Metal Pretreatment & Surface Preparation
* Metallurgy & Industrial Corrosion Protection
* C5 / CX Corrosion Protection Applications
* Automotive Coating Specifications & Quality Systems
* Salt Spray Testing, Corrosion Testing & Coating Performance Evaluation

**Experience in industrial paints, surface finishing, zinc lamellar coatings, fastener manufacturing or corrosion protection will be a strong advantage.**

**Educational Qualifications (Preferred):**

* Degree / Diploma in Paint Technology or Surface Coating Technology
* B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical, Mechanical or Metallurgical Engineering

Candidates with equivalent qualifications and significant relevant industry experience may also be considered.

**Essential Skills:**

* Proven experience in technical B2B sales and new customer acquisition.

For UAE positions, existing experience and customer connections within the UAE or wider GCC industrial market will be preferred.

* Technical and commercial support from EFFCO's experienced team.

• Build a culture of accountability, consistency and continuous improvement.

**2. B2B Telemarketing & Lead Qualification**

• Manage outbound calling campaigns targeting US and other approved international B2B markets.

• Ensure agents understand campaign ICP, target accounts, buyer personas and qualification

requirements.

• Guide teams across MQL, SAL, Intent, ANT, BANT and SQL qualification programs.

• Train agents to identify business challenges, buyer interest, decision-making authority and

timelines.

• Ensure qualification evidence is captured accurately rather than assumed.

• Maintain lead quality, data accuracy and compliance with agreed client criteria.

• Monitor lead rejection reasons and implement corrective actions.

**3. Appointment Generation & Sales Conversations**

• Lead appointment generation campaigns involving senior B2B decision-makers.

• Coach agents on prospect research, cold-call openings, discovery questions, value articulation and

objection handling.

• Improve conversion from conversations to qualified meetings.

• Ensure appointments meet agreed campaign criteria before client handoff.

• Support meeting confirmations, follow-ups and rescheduling.

• Review meeting outcomes and use feedback to improve qualification and calling effectiveness.

**4. Campaign Execution & Client Delivery**

• Translate campaign briefs into practical execution plans for the calling team.

• Understand campaign goals, qualification frameworks, delivery timelines and acceptance criteria.

• Collaborate with Campaign Operations, Quality and Revenue Execution teams.

• Monitor campaign pacing, conversion trends, lead quality and delivery risks.

• Escalate operational issues proactively and recommend corrective action.

• Ensure CRM updates, disposition codes, call notes and qualification records are accurate and

complete.

• Support reporting and campaign reviews with actionable insights.

**5. Coaching, Quality & Continuous Improvement**

• Conduct regular call listening and structured feedback sessions.

• Develop scripts, discovery frameworks and objection-handling playbooks.

• Improve agent confidence when engaging Directors, VPs, CXOs and other senior decision-makers.

• Identify effective messaging, call approaches and qualification questions.

• Share campaign-level insights to improve targeting, messaging and performance.

• Lead by example through live calling, demonstrations and difficult prospect conversations when

required.

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential Requirements**

• Graduate degree from a recognized university.

• 4–8 years of relevant experience in B2B telemarketing, international lead generation, lead

qualification or appointment generation.

• At least 1–2 years of experience leading a calling or appointment generation team.

• Demonstrated experience working on US-market B2B campaigns.

• Strong understanding of MQL, SAL, BANT and SQL qualification methodologies.

• Practical experience conducting cold calls, discovery conversations and objection handling.

• Experience managing campaign delivery targets, agent performance and quality standards.

• Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

• Proficiency with CRM systems, calling platforms, Excel and performance reporting.

• Ability and willingness to work from our Pune office during US business hours.

**Preferred Experience**

• B2B technology, SaaS, cloud, IT services or cybersecurity campaigns.

• Appointment generation targeting enterprise or mid-market decision-makers.

• Managing multiple client campaigns with different qualification requirements.

• Coaching underperforming agents and improving team conversion rates.

• Working with US-based clients or stakeholders.

• Familiarity with account-based marketing and target-account lists.

**How You'll Make a Difference**

Your impact will go beyond the number of calls your team makes.

You'll help us:

-
**Turn activity into quality:**

Improve the proportion of conversations that produce relevant, validated buyer

intelligence.

-
**Build stronger talent:**

Develop agents who can confidently engage business decision-makers rather than

simply read scripts.

-
**Improve client outcomes:**

Ensure the leads and appointments delivered align with agreed qualification

standards.

-
**Create execution consistency:**

Build repeatable calling, coaching, quality and reporting practices.

-
**Strengthen Sales readiness:**

Help clients receive better-qualified buyers with clearer context for follow-up.

-
**Build a performance-driven team:**

Create an environment where productivity, quality, ownership and

professional development reinforce one another

.
**What Success Looks Like**

Your performance will be evaluated across both productivity and delivery quality, including:

• Daily calling and outreach productivity against defined team targets.

• Meaningful conversation and connection rates.

• Lead qualification and acceptance rates.

• Qualified appointments scheduled and held, where contracted.

• Campaign delivery against agreed timelines and requirements.

• CRM accuracy, documentation and compliance.

• Team coaching effectiveness and individual performance improvement.

• Client feedback, campaign quality and operational consistency.

**We value measurable outcomes not activity numbers alone.**

**Why Join Intent Amplify?**

**1. Lead a team that contributes to real commercial outcomes.**

You'll help shape how B2B technology

companies identify, engage and qualify prospective buyers.

**2. Work beyond traditional telemarketing.**

Gain exposure to demand generation, account-based

marketing, buyer intelligence, qualification frameworks and pipeline activation.

**3. Develop leadership capabilities.**

Own team coaching, execution quality, performance improvement

and campaign delivery.

**4. Gain exposure to international B2B markets.**

Work on programs involving US-market technology

companies, enterprise audiences and senior decision-makers.

**5. Influence how campaigns are executed.**

Your insights from live prospect conversations can directly

inform messaging, qualification and operational improvements.

**6. Grow with a revenue-focused organization.**

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to evolving

sales processes, team capabilities and scalable delivery practices.

**Who Will Thrive Here?**

- Someone who enjoys developing people but is equally comfortable getting involved in execution.

- Someone who can explain why a campaign isn't performing and knows how to improve it.

- Someone who understands that a successful calling team needs strong conversations, accurate

qualification, consistent coaching and disciplined execution.

- Most importantly, someone who takes ownership of outcomes rather than simply supervising

activities.

**If you believe great teams create great conversations and great conversations create stronger**

**commercial opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.**

**Apply:**

Share your updated resume with our recruitment team, mentioning Team Lead – Operations in

the subject line.

Magarpatta Cybercity, Hadapsar, Pune

Full-Time | Work From Office | US Shift

description:
As the 

leader in Identity Security

,

**,**
delivering the central control point for risk management for the enterprise.

**AI and machine learning Identity Security platform.**
Organizations don’t know what data they have; let alone where it resides and crucially: who/what has access: we help them answer those key questions. Identity security is the central control point for risk management for the enterprise: the easiest way to implement your digital transformation faster and reduce risk.

Our employees voted us “best places to work” – 10 years in a row.

**Strategic Sales Representative**

We are seeking an experienced Strategic Sales Representative, to sell our IGA Solution Suite to $5B+ organizations.  Primarily a SaaS offering, our IGA Solution Suite sits at the heart of an organization’s enterprise security.  The position requires a sales executive who is experienced in navigating multinational accounts, generally at C level.  The successful candidate will use their previous experience in SaaS, Cyber-sec or IAM/IGA to negotiate high value contracts across what is generally a lengthy sales cycle.

Using the Challenger sales methodology, quota will be achieved by engaging with approximately 10 target customers: typically, there will be a large number of POC’s, BVA’s & RFP’s as a part of the sales motion.  Route to market is selling to end users directly and also leveraging the support of our influential channel partners, including the GSI’s, such as Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG. Our Sales Executives gain a thorough understanding of prospective client's business and the industry in which they compete, the corresponding IT initiatives, identifying business drivers/needs which the company can help resolve, developing compelling business value propositions for our solutions and ultimately closing business. They will also develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior level decision makers and other key buyers within the named accounts and partners.

**The path to success:**

**In setting the right foundations, you should achieve these milestones during your 1st month with the company.**

* Established internal network & led interlock meetings with virtual teams & key stakeholders.
* Schedule weekly 1:1 meeting cadence with your Manager with TAM review agenda.
* Ensure you have a buddy assigned and meet with them at least once a week.
* Demonstrate your understanding of financial terms and how we currently measure financial success at SailPoint.
* Familiarize yourself with SailPoint's language of acronyms and technical terms so you can actively participate in meetings.
* Ask your manager to share the strategic objectives of your department followed by your team's objectives and finally where your role fits in.
* Achieved “Bosun” enablement badge.

**Continuing to build those foundations you should have achieved these milestones by the end of your 2nd month.**

* Sorted TAM accounts into Sales priority order and reset/clean pipeline.
* Set $$ amounts next to all “A” accounts & make introductions with them.
* Territory plan developed, presented and signed off by Sales Management

* Created a stakeholder map for key partners that are influencers in your “A” accounts and devised approaches to connect with them.
* Presented pipeline growth plan to Management.
* Demonstrated SFDC hygiene with regular, accurate activity and updates.
* Complete the Crew Member Value Proposition Tool and schedule time with your manager to discuss.

**Building on the foundations, you should have achieved these milestones by the end of your 3rd month.**

* Implemented an operating cadence with virtual team (meetings in place with clear purpose)

* Developed strategies to approach “A” accounts - presented to Management and approved.
* Customers from “A” accounts know who you are – relationship maps in SFDC completed.
* Achieved “1st Mate” enablement badge.

**By the end of your 4th month, in addition to the attainment and continued development of your first 3 months activities, you will have:**

* Created Account plans for all ‘A’ accounts.
* Created Opportunity plans for all ‘A’ accounts.
* Presented forecast for self-generated opportunities & expected time/path to 1st sale.
* Shown progress through sales stages for any inbound/inherited opportunities (from 5-40).
* Achieved “Sailing Master” enablement badge.

**On completing your first successful 6 months at SailPoint, in addition to the previous milestones, you will have:**

* Achieved strong correlation between engagement rate and all ‘A’ accounts.
* Achieved strong correlation between pitch rate and all ‘A’ accounts.
* “Quarter Master” enablement badge completed.
* “Captain” enablement badge completed (including stand and deliver)

Preferred but not required: Bachelor's degree or global equivalent in an IT, business or sales related field.

**Travel:**

Business travel of approximately 50 percent yearly is expected for this position

This role will be based in Delhi.

title: Services Sales Executive-IT Sale/SaaS
description:
**SERVICES SALES EXECUTIVE — INDIA**

Software Development & Managed Engineering · 12th Wonder · Pune

12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100+ Indian enterprises since 2012. The delivery engine is proven — 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews.

What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new-logo deals across India.

**THE ROLE**

This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them.

**You'll spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers**
— identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan.

**You own your territory and your number.**
You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity — but the deal is yours to win or lose.

**Your buyer:**
India-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments — automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R&D centres. Rupee-denominated, relationship-led, CXO-level deals averaging ~₹20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan–Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a morning's drive.

**WHAT YOU'RE SELLING**

Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models:

**Custom software development.**
Full-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients — web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships.

**Managed engineering teams.**
Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the client's product or platform roadmap. Longer-duration, higher-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure.

Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a ₹15–25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3–5x the initial contract value

**MILESTONES**

***Exhibit 1: Year-one de***

**First 30 days**

Territory plan defined. Target account list of 50+ accounts built and prioritised. CRM configured. First outbound sequences live.

**First 60 days**

Minimum 15 first meetings completed. At least 5 qualified opportunities in pipeline with identified budget and decision-maker.

﻿First 90 days

Pipeline value at 2x forward target. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation

**First 180 days**

First closed-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. Clear expansion path identified in at least two landed accounts

**End of year one**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue — roughly four deals at our average size. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team.

**COMPENSATION**

Cash role — fixed plus variable, no ESOP attached. We'd rather be transparent about the economics than quote an OTE and let you reverse-engineer it.

***Exhibit 2: Compensation structure***

Fixed ₹12–15L

Target ₹75 lakh

Variable Plan ₹5.6L

OTE AT Plan ₹18–21L

**FIXARGE**
**VARIABLE AT PLA**
**OTE AT PLA**

**Variable is a flat 7.5% of closed revenue, uncapped.**
The rate doesn't taper past target — close ₹1 crore and the plan pays ₹7.5L variable, no renegotiation. Variable pays pro-rata from 70% of target, on revenue closed at or above floor margin. We're not going to pay you to discount, and you shouldn't want a plan that does.

**DETAILS**

***Exhibit 3: Role parameters***

**Location**

Pune. Remote (India) considered for strong candidates, with monthly onsite weeks.

**Buyer geography**

India-domiciled enterprises

**Reports to**

Chief Operating Officer

**Year-one target**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue

**Typical deal size**

~₹20 lakh

**Travel**

~30%, primarily metro India and the Pune industrial belt

**Team**

Individual contributor. Pre-sales and delivery support on qualified deals.

**Start**

Immediate

**HOW HIRING WORKS**

Three conversations over about two weeks:

**1. Screening call (30 min)**
— your track record, deal examples, and whether the buyer profile matches what you've sold.

**2. Pipeline walkthrough (60 min)**
— pick one of your best deals and walk us through it end-to-end: how you found it, how you qualified it, how you closed it, and what you'd do differently.

**3. Leadership conversation (45 min)**
— with the COO: territory, the number, and the terms.

Decision within 5 working days of the last conversation, either way.

title: Sales & Back Office Executive – Exports at Briomagic Private Limited, Pune
description:
We are looking for a sharp, reliable and street-smart professional to handle export sales coordination and back-office operations end to end – from buyer enquiry and costing, to raw material and trading orders, factory follow-up, dispatch and export documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Buyer Coordination**

•    Handle buyer enquiries, prepare quotations and price lists, and follow up for order confirmation.

•    Calculate product costing, FOB/CIF pricing and margins accurately in Excel.

•    Maintain regular, professional email communication with overseas buyers (mainly USA).

•    Track buyer requirements: specifications, samples, packing, labelling and delivery timelines.

**Procurement & Factory Follow-up**

•    Place purchase orders for raw materials (polymer, graphite, paper, packaging, etc.) and for traded products with suppliers.

•    Negotiate rates, compare quotes and ensure the best price, quality and delivery terms.

•    Follow up daily with our factory and partner factories on production status, quality and dispatch dates.

•    Keep a live order tracker so management knows the status of every order at any time.

**Dispatch, Logistics & Export Documentation**

•    Coordinate with freight forwarders, CHA and transporters for pickup, container booking and shipment.

•    Prepare and verify export documents: commercial invoice, packing list, shipping bill, bill of lading/airway bill, certificate of origin, etc.

•    Handle GST, LUT, drawback/RoDTEP and payment realisation follow-up (FIRC/BRC) with accounts/CA.

•    Calculate CBM, container loading, carton quantities and weights correctly for every shipment.

**Back Office & Reporting**

•    Maintain orders, stock, dispatch and payment records in Excel.

•    Prepare weekly reports on orders, pending dispatches, payments and supplier performance.

•    Flag delays, quality issues or cost changes to management immediately, with a proposed solution.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

•    Fair working knowledge of export processes: Incoterms (FOB, CIF, EXW), IEC, LUT, shipping documents, freight forwarding and payment terms (advance, LC, TT).

•    Strong basic mathematics and unit conversions – cm ↔ mm ↔ inch, kg ↔ tons, CBM, percentages, margins, currency conversion – done quickly and without errors.

•    Good Excel skills: formulas (SUM, IF, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF), pivot tables, costing sheets and trackers.

•    Experience in raw material / trading order placement and supplier follow-up.

•    Good written and spoken English; professional email etiquette.

•    Working knowledge of GST on exports and basic accounting terms.

**Personal Attributes**

•    Street-smart: knows how to negotiate, read people, spot errors and get things done with suppliers and transporters.

•    Highly follow-up oriented – does not wait to be chased; closes every loop.

•    Detail-oriented with numbers, quantities and documents; double-checks before sending.

•    Takes ownership, solves problems independently and escalates early when needed.

•    Honest, dependable and discreet with pricing, supplier and buyer information.

**Good to Have**

•    Prior experience in stationery, paper, printing or other manufacturing/export industry.

•    Knowledge of US buyer requirements (labelling, packaging, compliance) and SMETA/social compliance basics.

•    Familiarity with Tally or any ERP; experience with Amazon/online marketplace exports.

**Qualification**

Graduate (B.Com / BBA / BMS or equivalent). Export-import diploma or course is an added advantage.

**Suggested Screening Test (for interview)**

•    Quick conversion test: cm to mm/inch, kg to tons, carton and CBM calculation.

•    Excel test: build a simple costing sheet with margin and currency conversion.

•    Scenario question: factory has delayed dispatch by 5 days and the buyer is waiting – what do you do?

**How to Apply**

* Send your resume with current CTC and expected CTC to the email  info@briomagic.com provided by Briomagic private limited, mentioning "Sales & Back Office – Exports" in the subject line.

He is responsible for financial sales, trade sales of respective distributors/towns assigned to him. The TSM is responsible for recruitment, training & development of frontline field force both 3rd party and that of Distributor.

**Responsibilities**
Responsibility for Financial & Trade Sales targets fulfilment for all distributors, towns & specified geography. Set up a business and personnel relationship with distributors in order to ensure the long-term success of Red Bull strategies. Implement & align the sales fundamentals (Distribution, Prices, Placements, POSM, Promotions, etc.) with distributor & customer. Measure these fundamentals and adapt them to maximize growth potential. The TSM is responsible for distributor claims, Inventory management, warehouse hygiene, automation, reporting any development at the distributor end related to the category. Recruitment, Training & Development of frontline field force (3rd Party, Distributors) in his area. Develop, propose, execute & review incentivization program for the on key deliverables. Plan & execute key marketing aligned activations for the specified geography, Customer in line with set company objective. Align with Field marketing team on sales drives, event sales and activations across channels. Ensure all relevant outlets within a specific geography are serviced, merchandised by distributors each month as per agreed sales plan across channels. Develop, implement coverage optimization plan as per the company guidelines. Ensure right pricing across store formats and channel. Execute planned programs, promotions & merchandise across customers across channels in the specified geography by guiding and motivating the frontline team across distributors. Drive incentive programs. Continuously develop and review guidelines to track & measure objectives on distribution, shelving, merchandising, and pricing in each outlet, city and area in total. Manage distributor inventory to prevent loss of sale on account of non-availability of stocks by effectively and efficiently working with distributor, warehouse & regional logistic team as per company specified standards. Maintain hygiene at the distributor warehouse as per regulatory and company specified norms. Timely submission of distributor claims along with proper company approved supporting. Resolving distributor queries if any by coordinating with regional finance. Drive alternate channel objective for the geography by getting the distributor and frontline team aligned to the channel requirements. Maintain relationship with to accounts across channels eg: Perfect Store, Bull Bars, Contracted accounts and Wholesale to help drive business objectives.

* Basic leadership quality
* Good communication, planning & presentation skills
* Analytical ability, logical thinking
* Passion for the Brand
