title: Services Sales Executive-IT Sales/SaaS
description:
**SERVICES SALES EXECUTIVE — INDIA**

Software Development & Managed Engineering · 12th Wonder · Pune

12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100+ Indian enterprises since 2012. The delivery engine is proven — 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews.

What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new-logo deals across India.

**THE ROLE**

This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them.

**You'll spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers**
— identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan.

**You own your territory and your number.**
You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity — but the deal is yours to win or lose.

**Your buyer:**
India-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments — automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R&D centres. Rupee-denominated, relationship-led, CXO-level deals averaging ~₹20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan–Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a morning's drive.

**WHAT YOU'RE SELLING**

Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models:

**Custom software development.**
Full-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients — web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships.

**Managed engineering teams.**
Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the client's product or platform roadmap. Longer-duration, higher-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure.

Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a ₹15–25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3–5x the initial contract value

**MILESTONES**

***Exhibit 1: Year-one de***

**First 30 days**

Territory plan defined. Target account list of 50+ accounts built and prioritised. CRM configured. First outbound sequences live.

**First 60 days**

Minimum 15 first meetings completed. At least 5 qualified opportunities in pipeline with identified budget and decision-maker.

﻿First 90 days

Pipeline value at 2x forward target. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation

**First 180 days**

First closed-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. Clear expansion path identified in at least two landed accounts

**End of year one**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue — roughly four deals at our average size. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team.

**COMPENSATION**

Cash role — fixed plus variable, no ESOP attached. We'd rather be transparent about the economics than quote an OTE and let you reverse-engineer it.

***Exhibit 2: Compensation structure***

Fixed ₹12–15L

Target ₹75 lakh

Variable Plan ₹5.6L

OTE AT Plan ₹18–21L

**FIXARGE**
**VARIABLE AT PLA**
**OTE AT PLA**

**Variable is a flat 7.5% of closed revenue, uncapped.**
The rate doesn't taper past target — close ₹1 crore and the plan pays ₹7.5L variable, no renegotiation. Variable pays pro-rata from 70% of target, on revenue closed at or above floor margin. We're not going to pay you to discount, and you shouldn't want a plan that does.

**DETAILS**

***Exhibit 3: Role parameters***

**Location**

Pune. Remote (India) considered for strong candidates, with monthly onsite weeks.

**Buyer geography**

India-domiciled enterprises

**Reports to**

Chief Operating Officer

**Year-one target**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue

**Typical deal size**

~₹20 lakh

**Travel**

~30%, primarily metro India and the Pune industrial belt

**Team**

Individual contributor. Pre-sales and delivery support on qualified deals.

**Start**

Immediate

**HOW HIRING WORKS**

Three conversations over about two weeks:

**1. Screening call (30 min)**
— your track record, deal examples, and whether the buyer profile matches what you've sold.

**2. Pipeline walkthrough (60 min)**
— pick one of your best deals and walk us through it end-to-end: how you found it, how you qualified it, how you closed it, and what you'd do differently.

**3. Leadership conversation (45 min)**
— with the COO: territory, the number, and the terms.

Decision within 5 working days of the last conversation, either way.

description:
**About BridgeYU**

BridgeYU is building the next generation of learning infrastructure. We empower educators, coaching institutes, schools, universities, and content creators to launch their own branded learning platforms with enterprise-grade features.

We’re at an exciting stage of our journey and looking for a Sales Specialist who wants to build, grow, and win with us. If you’re an optimistic, target-driven seller who thrives on turning opportunities into customers and enjoys building something from the ground up, we’d love to meet you.

**Role Description**

We’re looking for a driven and optimistic Sales Specialist to help scale BridgeYU from 0 to 1.

This role is for someone who loves selling, takes ownership of targets, and sees challenges as opportunities. You’ll be responsible for building a strong sales pipeline, identifying the right customers, converting leads into paying customers, and consistently delivering measurable revenue growth.

You won’t just manage an existing pipeline—you’ll create opportunities, experiment with sales strategies, build relationships, and develop repeatable processes that drive business growth. Working closely with the founders, you’ll play a key role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and establishing BridgeYU’s presence in the market.

We’re looking for a positive, persistent, and results-oriented seller who believes in the product, enjoys talking to customers, and is motivated by achieving—and exceeding—targets.

***Note: Candidates with their own laptop and personal transportation will be preferred***
.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Sales Targets:**
  Take complete ownership of revenue goals, consistently meet targets, and work towards exceeding them.
* **Build from 0 to 1:**
  Create and grow the sales pipeline from scratch by identifying potential customers and exploring new opportunities.
* **Generate Quality Leads:**
  Drive lead generation through outbound outreach, referrals, partnerships, networking, and other effective channels.
* **Convert Prospects into Customers:**
  Lead prospects through the sales journey with consultative selling, effective communication, and consistent follow-ups.
* **Maintain a Winning Mindset:**
  Stay optimistic and persistent through rejections, handle objections confidently, and find ways to move deals forward.
* **Build Scalable Sales Processes:**
  Develop sales playbooks, improve follow-up strategies, and create repeatable systems for consistent growth.
* **Track Performance:**
  Monitor sales KPIs, pipeline health, conversion rates, and revenue performance to continuously improve results.
* **Collaborate with Founders:**
  Work closely with the founding team to refine messaging, understand customer needs, and explore new market opportunities.
* **Build Long-Term Relationships:**
  Deliver a strong customer experience that encourages retention, referrals, and long-term partnerships.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in sales, business development, or customer acquisition, preferably in an EdTech startup, SaaS company, or high-growth environment.
* A proven ability to generate leads independently, convert prospects, and consistently work towards sales targets.
* Strong communication, persuasion, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* A positive, optimistic, and resilient attitude, with the ability to stay motivated despite setbacks and rejections.
* A target-driven mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency.
* Understanding of B2B sales, customer acquisition, and sales pipeline management.
* A data-driven approach to tracking performance, identifying bottlenecks, and improving conversions.
* Comfort working in an early-stage startup where you may need to build processes from scratch and wear multiple hats.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, sales automation platforms, and prospecting tools is a plus.
* Prior EdTech or SaaS sales experience is preferred, but a strong sales mindset and the ability to deliver results matter most.

**Who Will Thrive at BridgeYU?**

* You enjoy selling and are excited by the challenge of building something from the ground up.
* You set ambitious targets and take ownership of achieving them.
* You see rejection as part of the process, not a reason to give up.
* You bring energy, optimism, and persistence to every sales conversation.
* You are proactive, resourceful, and focused on outcomes rather than just activity.
* You want to make a tangible impact on a growing business and grow alongside the company.

If you’re hungry to build, passionate about sales, and ready to turn opportunities into revenue, we’d love to hear from you. Join BridgeYU and help us scale from 0 to 1!

title: Technical Sales And Business Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Tekor Minerals (TEKOR) is a leading manufacturer of high-performance fluxes serving the Iron and Steel industry. The company has an established global presence across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe, supplying solutions that support efficient and reliable steel production. Tekor Minerals focuses on product effectiveness, consistent quality, and technical support to meet demanding industrial requirements. Team members have the opportunity to work in an international business environment, collaborate with industry professionals, and contribute to growth in key global markets.
  
**Role Description**
The Technical Sales and Business Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City. This role is responsible for managing and expanding customer accounts in the Iron and Steel sector, identifying new business opportunities, and promoting TEKOR’s flux products to prospective clients. Daily activities include meeting with customers, providing technical product demonstrations and recommendations, preparing proposals and quotations, and following up on leads to convert them into long-term partnerships. The position also involves coordinating with internal technical and production teams to ensure timely delivery, resolving customer issues, and gathering market intelligence to support pricing, product development, and strategic decision-making. The Executive is expected to maintain accurate sales reports, achieve assigned targets, and represent TEKOR professionally at industry events and client meetings.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong technical understanding of metallurgical processes, especially in the Iron and Steel industry, and the ability to translate technical product features into customer benefits.
* Proven sales, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills, with experience managing industrial or B2B accounts.
* Business development capabilities, including market research, lead generation, opportunity assessment, and strategic planning.
* Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information to diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to work on-site, travel to customer locations as needed, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Metallurgy, Mechanical, Chemical) or a related technical field; a business or MBA qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in the steel, metals, or industrial chemicals sector is highly beneficial.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools, with strong organizational and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated initiative, goal orientation, and a commitment to ethical, non-discriminatory professional conduct.

title: Senior Business Development Associate
description:
***Minimac Systems***
 is a deep\-tech company building the circular economy for industrial lubricants.
 



  





 Our premise is simple: oil doesn't wear out, it just gets dirty. Since 2012, we have been extending the working life of industrial oils through miniaturised fluid\-treatment systems, oil condition monitoring and Recycling on Wheels, our mobile service that restores oil on site. Next is Lubricants as a Service, where customers pay for uptime, not litres.
 



  





 The numbers so far: 2,500\+ systems deployed, 2,200\+ industrial assets served and 14 million\+ litres of lubricant kept in productive use, for customers including NTPC, Adani Power, JSW Steel and Tata Steel.
 



 Minimac is backed by Rainmatter (Zerodha).
 



  





**Role Description** 




 Full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune.
 



  





 This is not a lead generation role. It is a strategy seat within business development, working directly with Minimac's leadership. You will research industries and large industrial groups, understand what their leadership teams care about, and align what Minimac offers with those priorities. The business follows from that work, usually over quarters, not weeks.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




 \- Research target sectors, large industrial groups and their priorities around cost, reliability and sustainability
 



 \- Build the business case for each opportunity: market sizing, cost\-benefit analysis and environmental impact
 



 \- Prepare CXO\-level engagements: briefing notes, strategy decks and proposals
 



 \- Work with our technical, operations and marketing teams so that what we propose is what we can deliver
 



 \- Support strategic partnerships, MOUs and new market entry, in India and overseas
 



 \- Carry a small number of strategic initiatives from research through to signed business
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or a related field; an MBA is a plus
 



 \- Experience in strategy, consulting, key account management or strategic business development, ideally in B2B industrial sectors
 



 \- Strong research and analytical skills: market sizing, account and competitor analysis, business case building
 



 \- Ability to structure a problem and present it clearly to senior leadership, in writing and in person
 



 \- Commercial sense: you can see how insight turns into revenue, even when the cycle is long
 



 \- Comfortable with open\-ended problems, working independently and across teams
 



 \- Exposure to engineering, energy or sustainability is an advantage

**The Role** 




 We are looking for a Team Lead to lead our corporate events team and own its commercial performance.
 



 You will manage 7 planners and 1 operations executive, with your primary focus on hitting revenue and margin targets, improving conversion, coaching planners to sell better, and maintaining high delivery standards.
 



 This is a player\-coach role. You will personally stay close to important opportunities and client situations while helping the team consistently perform at a higher level.

**1\. Own Team Revenue \& Performance** 




 • Own monthly team targets for revenue, gross margin, conversion and productivity.

**2\. Coach the Team to Sell Better**

 • Personally handle selected high\-value opportunities and important client escalations.

 • Ensure planners are selling profitable events, not just chasing topline revenue.
 



 • Maintain strong client relationships and drive repeat business.
 



**4\. Maintain Event\-Planning Quality** 




 • Use your event and venue expertise to challenge proposals, commercials and delivery plans where required.
 



 • Help planners anticipate operational risks before they reach the client.
 



 • Ensure strong handover from sale through event delivery and closure.
 



**5\. Help us Improve Through AI \& Product** 




 • Drive adoption of our AI tools across the team.
 



 • Identify where AI, automation or better workflows can improve sales productivity and conversion.
 



 • Share structured feedback with Product based on real planner and client problems.
 



 • Help the team adapt quickly as our systems and workflows evolve.
 



  





**Must Have** 




 • 6–10 years of total experience

 • Experience in corporate events, MICE, hospitality, hotel banquets, event production, travel, events agencies or another relevant customer\-facing commercial environment

 • Experience coaching and improving sales performance within a team
 



 • Strong understanding of revenue, gross margin and conversion
 



 • Strong spoken and written English
 



 • Comfortable working with dashboards, CRM and performance data

title: AO/RFP Writer - Fixed Income
description:
**Job Description**
*AllianceBernstein’s Client Group has a presence in the Americas, Europe, Asia and Australia, and is composed of five main areas:*
* Sales \& Client Services works with financial intermediaries and institutions to offer diversified investment solutions that help clients build and preserve their wealth
* Business Development is a conduit to the firm’s investment teams and supports our clients and internal business partners through investment\-platform and product content, messaging, competitive analysis and education
* Product Strategy \& Development designs, develops and manages the firm’s global lineup of investment services and considers clients’ evolving needs to identify new opportunities
* Marketing promotes the firm and its services by creating, packaging and distributing content and messaging to engage diverse audiences through digital platforms and initiatives, strategic campaigns, and events
* Business Transformation looks to evolve and scale our business, leveraging digital and data, to drive top\-line growth and improve profitability


**What You’ll Do**
*AllianceBernstein’s Request for Proposal (RFP) team is in search of a RFP writer to contribute to business development and client service through the completion of RFPs, RFIs, as well as some due diligence requests for AllianceBernstein’s Fixed Income Strategies. The Writer will specialize in writing RFPs for our Fixed Income Strategies in a timely and accurate manner, while also contributing, where needed, to the completion of other projects and requests. The Writer will be expected to be able to work effectively with the firm’s Senior RFP Writers and Management Team, Product Managers and Portfolio Managers, as well as our Sales Teams, to write and maintain (keep updated) original and technical product\-specific content to support our Fixed Income platform, and, importantly, to be able to effectively customize that content for specific sales situations as needed.*
*This position will provide an opportunity to develop knowledge in the entire new business development process: from the initial screening of an RFP, to the organization and project management of an RFP, to the actual content creation and updating of RFP language and then, finally, to the follow\-up and tracking of our RFPs. The candidate will be expected to handle a high volume of requests simultaneously and productively. Projects will be primarily related to new business opportunities, as well as some client servicing\-related including Onboarding Questionnaires and client Due Diligence Questionnaires.*
**Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Write a high volume of RFPs for Fixed Income strategies and support other asset classes as needed.
* Liaise with various departments throughout the firm to collect information needed to respond to requests, including but not limited to portfolio management, product management/marketing, legal, operations, AUM reporting and performance.
* Create and maintain RFP language and content for assigned strategies of coverage, including investment process, research process, team information, and competitive advantages.
* Maintain consistent product messaging and updated product language in our RFP database.
* Collaborate directly with Product Managers, Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, Traders, and others to update existing RFP language and develop new language.
* Customize final documents to reflect a nuanced and targeted response to the specific sales opportunity.
* Handle follow\-up work associated with RFPs moving to the next phase: coordinating answers, additional information, etc.
* Oversee production of final proposals (formatting, technical editing and reproduction).
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously to meet strict deadlines.
* Field ad\-hoc questions from our Client Response Center Team daily, as needed.


**What We’re Looking For**
*The ideal candidate should have:*
* Knowledge of the broader fixed income market and the asset management industry.
* Detail\-oriented with excellent project management and organizational skills; able to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks to ensure that complex projects are completed by deadline, with interim review steps incorporated.
* Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a large global organization.
* Demonstrated desire and ability to learn technical info, including philosophy, research and investment processes of our products.
* Demonstrated initiative and good judgment as well as the ability to work well under pressure and with time constraints.
* Interest in and ability to interact directly and effectively with Sales Advisors, Portfolio Managers and other investment professionals.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Word, and possess the ability to quickly master internal systems and applications.
* Experience: 5\-8 years of RFP and industry experience required. Direct experience with Fixed Income RFP content is required.
* Education: CFA Level I cleared \& MBA Finance


**About AB**
*We are a leading global investment management firm offering high\-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private\-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.*
*Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought\-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!*

title: Spare Parts Package Coordinator
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Spare Parts Package Coordinator
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Title \- Spare Parts Package Coordinator
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your department
   

  

 The Global Spare Parts Department is part of the Business Unit Supply. The Global Spare Parts team is end\-to\-end responsible for the spare parts activities for Vanderlande’s Customer Centers (CC’s) and their customers. Global Spare Parts department is creating a Center of Competence in our Global Capability Center at Pune, India. Global Spare Parts is organized in three departments.
   

  

 Global Spare Parts
   

  

* Spare Parts Marketing manages the spare parts product portfolio to improve the parts value proposition to the Vanderlande CC’s and Customers. The activities include Product Life Cycle management with a strong focus on digitalization and B2B e\-commerce. The team manages the global pricing, product content and builds a strong relation with in\- and external stakeholders.
* Global Support supports the global customer base with spare parts offerings throughout the life\-time of the material handling assets. This includes the development of initial spare parts packages and day to day technical and commercial spare parts support. The department advises customers to optimize the on\-site stock availability.
* Spare Parts Logistics manages the central parts warehouse and is responsible for all in\- and outbound warehouse activities. They manage stock\-levels, lead\-times and on\-time shipment and delivery of parts from suppliers and deliveries to the global Vanderlande customer base


 Your position
   

  

 You will be the first point of contact for the customers’ spare parts related questions and requests. You will own the ordering process and will keep the customer up to date with the delivery information.
   

  

 Where necessary, you will also check the technical documentation (Bill of Material) in order to find out what parts are needed for the customer.
   

  

 Tasks And Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage customer\-specific spare parts package activities from project initiation through completion.
* Collect, validate, and maintain supplier spare parts data, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Identify portfolio gaps, create missing material master records, prepare BIT files, and maintain installed base information.
* Develop and maintain Bills of Material (BOMs), spare parts package structures, and related master data.
* Prepare preliminary budgets and customer quotations using SPARQ, FileMaker (CAP), SCCT, and manual quotation processes.
* Process SQ quotations, spare parts orders, SD/OD orders, and associated project documentation.
* Plan and monitor spare parts deliveries, ensuring timely execution and follow\-up within JDE.
* Partner with Project Managers to align spare parts deliverables with project schedules and implementation milestones.
* Prioritize project activities, monitor progress, and ensure on\-time completion of assigned deliverables.
* Serve as the primary liaison for regional Spare Parts Coordinators, promoting effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
* Standardize global spare parts processes, templates, and governance while supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive operational excellence through process optimization, automation, and best\-practice implementation.
* Collaborate with Service, Sales, Supply Chain, and Project teams to deliver customer\-focused lifecycle support solutions.
* Perform installed\-base and bottleneck analyses to identify operational risks and recommend optimized spare parts strategies.
* Develop customer\-specific stocking concepts and lifecycle service recommendations to improve equipment availability and reliability.
* Support strategic initiatives that enhance lifecycle services, increase spare parts revenue, improve customer retention, and strengthen long\-term customer value.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and global teams to ensure seamless communication and execution.
* Uphold Toyota Automated Logistics values by demonstrating customer focus, collaboration, accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.


**Requirements**
* At least a bachelor’s degree, preferably Business Administration or a similar
* Relevant 5\-7 years' experience in a B2B techno\-commercial environment.
* Experience in Spare Parts Order Management.
* Knowledge of Material Planning and Inventory Management
* Must have general technical knowledge of spare parts \& able to read technical data sheets and drawings
* Good negotiation skills to develop local buying
* Strong administrational skills with knowledge of Microsoft Office (specifically MS Excel)
* Experience with ERP
* Good command of the English language (Speaking and Writing)
* Experience in handling multiple tasks in a high\-energy office
* Proactive and customer service\-minded
* Strong work ethic and initiative, who would like to grow and develop within the organization
* Takes full ownership and responsibilities of their assignments
* Believe in Self\-alignment with all stake holders


 Diversity \& inclusion
   

  

 Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

* Create and schedule polished social media posts across LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and company channels to build brand awareness.

* Willingness and flexibility to work regular Night Shifts / US business hours to engage prospects, handle live responses, and set up meetings across US time zones.

description:
****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





 To know more, please visit : www.skf.com /in

 The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.

 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****Key Responsibilities****




**Business Growth**

**Sales Leadership**




* Build, lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Inside Sales team.

**Sales Excellence**




* Establish scalable inside sales processes, CRM discipline, pipeline management, and forecasting.

**Customer \& Commercial Excellence**




* Strengthen customer relationships through proactive engagement and structured account management.
* Enhance customer experience by ensuring timely follow\-up, quotation management, and issue resolution.

**Business Analytics \& Collaboration**




* Provide accurate sales forecasts, dashboards, and business insights to support decision\-making.

* Collaborate closely with Field Sales, Distribution Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Product Management, and Supply Chain to drive business growth.






**Key Performance Indicators**




* Revenue \& Margin Achievement
* New Customer Acquisition \& Customer Retention
* Pipeline Coverage \& Forecast Accuracy

****Education \& Experience****

* Digital Selling \& Sales Transformation

**Interested candidates can share their resume to prachi.chourasia@skf.com**

 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. title: Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
   

  

 As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
   

  

 In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies. Regional travel up to 35%.

title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Application/Sys Sales Eng II
description:
**Job Description**
 The Application Engineer is primarily responsible for preparation of technical and commercial customer proposals during the sales process. He/She will exhibit genuine interest in solving work problems through proactively asking questions, clearly communicating and collaborating both internally and externally to grow the business. In addition, the Application Engineer is responsible for understanding our competition and customers and showing initiative to learn and continuously improve company processes.
   

  

 The Application Engineer assists in developing and maintaining tools used in the front\-end engineering and quotation process. These tools include Excel spreadsheets, Word documents, and Access databases, as well as our ERP database. Also, would assist in organizing and modification of control system drawings, sales literature and promotional documentation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work to distill and organize technical and commercial proposal data into spreadsheets and word documents and/or databases.
* Analyze project requirements and gather necessary information to prepare proposals.
* Work to get external offers from possible sub\-vendors and evaluate which is technically and commercially adequate as part of CCC solution.
* Prepare comprehensive technical proposals, including scope of work, project timelines, and cost estimates.
* Conduct technical research and feasibility studies to support proposal development.
* Ensure that proposals comply with company standards and meet client specifications.
* Collaborate with the procurement team to obtain accurate pricing and availability of materials and services.
* Review and revise proposals based on client feedback and requirements.
* Coordinate with project managers and engineers to ensure a smooth transition from proposal to project execution.
* Participate in pre\-bid meetings and technical discussions with clients.
* Stay updated on industry trends, market conditions, and competitors’ offerings to enhance proposal competitiveness.
* Assist in preparing presentation materials for client meetings and bid presentations.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple proposals simultaneously.
* Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in proposal preparation.
* Provide fundamental technical support for the sales process, and specific assigned front\-end engineering projects.
* Provide technical analysis, troubleshooting and solutions
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external contacts.
* Maintain sensitive and confidential information regarding company information.
* Respond to change productively and handle other duties as required.
* Follow all company safety policies and procedures.


**Qualifications**
**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE**
* University Degree in Engineering
* more than 7 years of experience in control systems engineering or related field or related experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience


**Knowledge \& Skills**
* Have analytical skills to recognize patterns in data, information or events to draw logical conclusions and make recommendations for action.
* Ability to efficiently use all Microsoft Office products.
* Ability to operate test equipment and obtain measurements and data.
* To use established computer programs to input data, run queries and perform analysis.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Provide limited technical knowledge in specific areas of engineering aspects.
* Demonstrated ability to continuously learn.
* Ability to read, speak, and write in English required.


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
 Work Environment: Proposal engineers typically work in an office setting, collaborating with various teams and departments within the organization. The work environment is professional and focused, with a mix of individual tasks and team meetings.
   

  

 Office Hours: The standard working hours for a Proposal Engineer are typically Monday to Friday (8 hours daily),. However, some flexibility in working hours may be required to accommodate client deadlines or project requirements.
   

  

 Travel: Proposal engineers may be required to travel occasionally to attend client meetings, pre\-bid discussions, industry conferences or to conduct site survey. The extent of travel may vary based on the nature of the projects and client locations.
   

  

 Deadlines: Proposal engineers often work under deadlines and face time\-sensitive fast track bids. This can lead to periods of high workload, especially when multiple proposals need to be prepared simultaneously. Effective time management and the ability to work well under pressure are essential skills for this role.
   

  

 Collaboration: Proposal engineers collaborate closely with sales teams, project managers, engineers, and other internal stakeholders. This involves effective communication, coordination, and the ability to work as part of a team.
   

  

**Additional Technical Knowledge \& Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Turbomachinery Control Systems, including compressor, gas turbine, and steam turbine control philosophies and operational requirements.
* Experience with Anti\-Surge Control (ASC) systems for centrifugal compressors, including surge curve interpretation, control valve sizing concepts, performance monitoring, and tuning methodologies.
* Knowledge of Gas Turbine Control Systems, including startup/shutdown sequences, fuel control, combustion management, load control, speed control, emissions control, and protection systems.
* Knowledge of Steam Turbine Control Systems, including governor control, speed/load control, extraction and admission control, overspeed protection, turbine supervision, and trip systems.
* Understanding of Compressor Control Applications, including capacity control, recycle control, performance optimization, and machinery protection integration.
* Familiarity with industry standards and practices related to turbomachinery control, machinery protection, and process automation.
* Knowledge of PLC systems, including system architecture, controller configuration, I/O design, redundancy concepts, and industrial automation applications.
* Experience with major automation platforms such as Allen\-Bradley (Rockwell), Siemens, Schneider Electric, GE, Honeywell, Yokogawa, Emerson DeltaV, and ABB is preferred.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA, OPC DA, Ethernet/IP, ProfiNet, ProfiBus, Foundation Fieldbus, HART, and Serial Communications.
* Understanding of control system networking, cybersecurity fundamentals, industrial Ethernet infrastructure, and remote monitoring solutions.
* Ability to analyze process dynamics and develop control strategies, perform control loop tuning, and support system troubleshooting and optimization activities.
* Ability to interpret P\&IDs and PFDs, control narratives, cause \& effect diagrams, instrument data sheets, and control system architecture drawings.
* Ability to perform technical evaluations of customer specifications and develop compliant automation and turbomachinery control system solutions.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:
**About Clean Harbors**
 Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $4\.3 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.
   

  

 Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

 oLead, mentor, and develop a team of Inside Sales Associates, ensuring they meet sales targets, maintain strong customer relationships, and adhere to company standards.
   

  

 oSet clear expectations for team performance, implementing corrective actions and training initiatives to drive both individual and team success.

Provide insights into how the products/services can meet specific customer needs and solve challenges. title: Sr Estimator
description:
**Responsibilities**
 Senior Estimator
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Estimator is responsible for leading the development, estimation, and delivery of high\-quality technical and commercial proposals for strategic Integrated Control \& Safety System (ICSS) projects. The role provides end\-to\-end ownership of the proposal process, including solution development, cost estimation, risk assessment, stakeholder coordination, vendor engagement, governance approvals, proposal submission, and post\-bid support.
   

  

 Working closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and external partners, the Senior Estimator develops competitive, compliant, and profitable solutions that maximize customer value while supporting Honeywell's strategic growth objectives. The role requires strong technical expertise, commercial acumen, leadership capability, and the ability to manage complex bid activities across multiple stakeholders and regions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Proposal Leadership and Strategy**
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional proposal teams to develop accurate, compliant, and commercially competitive proposals within established timelines.
* Own the end\-to\-end proposal development process, from opportunity qualification through submission and post\-bid support.
* Participate in bid/no\-bid reviews and contribute to proposal strategy, risk mitigation, and win themes.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive Proposal Execution Plans, including resource allocation, deliverables, responsibilities, milestones, and submission schedules.
* Lead the preparation and successful submission of large\-scale, complex proposals and tenders, including multi\-country and international projects.


**Technical Solution Development**
* Analyze customer requirements, requests for quotation, specifications, and supporting documents to develop technically compliant and commercially viable solutions.
* Analyze, design, and develop end\-to\-end ICSS solutions, with a primary focus on Distributed Control Systems (DCS), SCADA, Process Safety Systems, PLCs, and associated automation technologies.
* Develop innovative technical and commercial alternatives that optimize competitiveness, profitability, risk profile, and customer value.
* Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and Honeywell strategic initiatives, including market verticalization, new product introduction, and other growth priorities.


**Estimating and Commercial Management**
* Prepare accurate cost estimates and commercial proposals for greenfield, brownfield, modernization, and service projects using approved methodologies, tools, and procedures.
* Conduct commercial reviews to identify risks, opportunities, cost drivers, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Develop pricing strategies that balance market competitiveness, customer value, and business profitability objectives.
* Use applicable systems and tools to maintain accurate documentation of estimates, proposals, assumptions, exclusions, and supporting information.


**Vendor and Stakeholder Management**
* Coordinate with Procurement and supporting functions to obtain technical and commercial quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, and third\-party vendors.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and customers to support proposal success.
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to develop optimized technical and commercial solutions.


**Proposal Governance and Compliance**
* Ensure complete and compliant responses to customer bid packages, including all required technical submissions, commercial documents, scope of supply, and supporting information.
* Prepare and submit required approval documentation in accordance with Honeywell governance requirements.
* Ensure proposals comply with customer specifications, company standards, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.


**Post\-Bid Support and Continuous Improvement**
* Support customer technical and commercial clarification activities following proposal submission and update proposals as required.
* Continuously enhance knowledge of Honeywell solutions, industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments.
* Drive standardization, process improvement, estimating best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives across the estimating community.
* Provide coaching, guidance, and mentoring to junior estimators and proposal engineers.


**Qualifications**
**Key Skills and Qualifications** 
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in Process Automation, Industrial Control Systems, or related engineering solutions.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in estimating, proposal management, bid execution, or commercial engineering roles.
* Proven experience successfully delivering complete proposals for large and complex projects, including international opportunities.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of process industries, including Oil \& Gas, Refining, Petrochemicals, LNG, Power, Mining, Metals, and Minerals.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in Industrial Control Systems, including DCS, SCADA, PLC, and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS).
* Experience with Honeywell automation solutions, including Experion, Safety Manager, FSC, and related technologies, is highly desirable.


**Leadership and Commercial Skills**
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including project costing, pricing strategy, margin analysis, and risk assessment.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong technical and integrative thinking skills, with the ability to develop innovative, customer\-focused solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.


**We Value**
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional value and service.
* Strategic thinking and strong business acumen.
* Strong technical aptitude and systems\-thinking capability.
* Knowledge of Honeywell's automation portfolio and competitive industry solutions.
* Ability to drive results and perform effectively in a fast\-paced bid environment.
* Strong planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work independently with limited direction while effectively leading project teams.
* Continuous learning mindset and commitment to professional development.
* Mentoring and coaching capability to support team development.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Head of Sales
description:
**Job Title: Head of Sales** 




**Location\- Pune, Bavdhan, (Onsite)** 




**Exp\- 8–12 years in residential real estate sales leadership, with at least one full cycle of a Rs. 300 Cr\+ project run end\-to\-end.** 




  





**SALES HEAD** 




  





**We're not hiring someone to manage a sales team. We're hiring someone to build one — from the ground up, around a new\-to\-market product: The Living Blueprint, India's first longevity\-led residential development.** 




  





**The playbook of buying leads, handing them to closers and hoping ATL spend converts doesn't work for a product this deep. We need a specialised, data\-driven, empathetic sales machine, built on the Predictable Revenue model — prospecting, qualification and closing run as three distinct systems, backed by CRM discipline, ICP rigour and SOPs that scale. Get this right at GLC, and the same playbook powers our next 30 million sq ft of TLB launches across Pune, Mumbai, Nagpur and NCR.** 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





**• The Sourcing Engine — Build and lead the SDR function, own the Ideal Client Profile, and run ATL, BTL and Channel Partner sourcing to deliver 6,000 qualified leads and 600 site walk\-ins a month.** 




  





**• The Qualification \& Nurture Layer — Build the MRR (qualifying) team, design the nurture flow that moves cold leads to sales\-ready, and fix the layer where most of today's pipeline is lost.** 




  





**• The Closing System — Design scripts and the "Objection Aikido" rebuttal library, and train Account Executives in empathetic, NLP\-informed selling that converts walk\-ins to bookings at 11%\+, with discount discipline held inside 6% of agreement value.** 




  





**• The Data \& SOP Backbone — Own the CRM end\-to\-end, build the MIS/analytics function, and implement the SOPs (including the 19\-touch connect system) that make the whole funnel observable and improvable, weekly.** 




  





**Plus full P\&L ownership of GLC sales, team leadership across sourcing, MRR, AE and support functions, Channel Partner strategy, and direct, weekly access to the Partner and Owner — no layers, no filtered reporting.** 




  





**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  





**We're hiring for the system\-building skill, not the industry on your resume. Real estate experience helps, but it isn't required — the right candidate could be coming from a completely different category.** 




  





**•12\+ years in senior sales leadership, having personally built and scaled a sales function for a large\-ticket, high\-consideration offering. Residential real estate is welcome but not required — we're equally open to wellness, hospitality, luxury automotive, private banking, or a comparable premium/category\-creating business, provided you've operated at a comparable scale (ideally the equivalent of a Rs. 300 Cr\+ project or portfolio).** 




**• Has built a sales system before, not just inherited one — can walk us through the org chart, CRM stack, script library and SOPs they personally designed.** 




**• Fluent in CRM as an operating discipline (HubSpot, Salesforce, LeadSquared, Sell.Do, Kylas, Zoho or similar) — the platform matters less than the discipline.** 




**• Reads dashboards and argues from data, not gut feel.** 




**• Personally credible with a longevity and wellness proposition — fitness\-oriented, curious about the science, respectful of an educated, long\-cycle buyer.** 




  





**This role is 20% closing, 80% building. It's not for the star closer who can't describe a repeatable system, the operator who thinks every gap needs a bigger ATL cheque, the GM who runs on WhatsApp and spreadsheets, or the closer who wins with pressure tactics and fake urgency. It is for someone willing to sit on the site\-office floor with the SDRs at 9am and role\-play scripts with the MRRs at 6pm — hands in the machine, for at least the first 12 months.** 




  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 




  





**Fixed compensation benchmarked at the 75th percentile of premium residential Sales Head roles in Pune/MMR, outcome\-linked variable pay (tied to booking value, walk\-in delivery, discount discipline and CP satisfaction — not activity metrics), and a long\-term, project\-completion incentive tied to the B7 sell\-out and B8 launch, paid over 24 months.**

 Site Visit Generation
 


* Convince qualified prospects to schedule site visits.
* Coordinate site visit schedules with customers and the internal team.
* Ensure maximum conversion of leads into site visits.



 Project Explanation
 


* Understand the assigned residential projects thoroughly.
* Explain project features, amenities, pricing, configurations, payment plans, and location advantages.
* Build trust and handle initial customer queries confidently.



 Follow\-up \& Conversion
 


* Maintain regular follow\-ups with customers after site visits.
* Understand objections and keep prospects engaged.
* Coordinate with the Closing Manager for advanced negotiations and closure.
* Follow up until the customer is successfully closed or the lead is disqualified.



 CRM \& Reporting
 


* Update CRM after every customer interaction.
* Maintain accurate lead status and follow\-up records.
* Submit daily calling and activity reports.
* Ensure no assigned lead is left unattended.



  




 Daily Responsibilities
 * 150–200 outbound calls
* Handle all assigned inbound leads
* Generate and schedule customer site visits
* Explain projects to prospective buyers
* Follow up with leads and site\-visit customers
* Coordinate with the Closing Manager
* Update CRM daily
* Submit end\-of\-day reports


**Required Skills** 
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi
* Confident and persuasive personality
* Comfortable speaking to customers over the phone
* Strong follow\-up and convincing abilities
* Basic computer, Excel, and CRM knowledge
* Target\-oriented and disciplined
* Willingness to learn real estate sales
* Ability to work from office every day


**Experience** 

 Freshers are welcome.
 



 Prior experience in telecalling, inside sales, customer service, or real estate is an advantage but not mandatory.
   




**Compensation** 

 Fixed Salary: Upto ₹15,000 per month \+ Attractive Performance\-Based Incentives
 



 Incentives are linked to site visits, conversions, and successful closures.
   




**Work Location \& Schedule** 
* Work From Office — Mandatory
* Full\-time role
* Pune


**Growth Opportunity** 

 Performing candidates can grow into:
 


* Senior Sales Executive
* Sales Consultant
* Closing Manager
* Business Development Manager


**Ideal Candidate** 

 This role is ideal for someone who:
 


* Is comfortable making a high volume of calls every day.
* Enjoys convincing and interacting with people.
* Is hungry to earn incentives through performance.
* Can handle rejection and maintain consistency.
* Takes ownership of leads and follow\-ups.
* Wants to build a long\-term career in real estate sales.
